title: Read deny rule like Read(/private/**) in user settings does not protect that absolute path
symptoms: Claude still reads files under the absolute path named in a deny rule
The rule in ~/.claude/settings.json matches ~/.claude/private instead of /private
cause: In permission rules a single leading slash is relative to the directory the settings file belongs to, not the filesystem root. Absolute paths need two leading slashes, and home paths use a tilde.
fix: Write absolute rules with // and home rules with ~/ in user settings, and test them with a read attempt.
affected: Claude Code permission rules, as of 2026-10
